close_step_note: Fresh 11-header sample, data/close_sample.json (n = 10 diffs, 10 s resolution). The 24 h mean measured 2026-11-24 -> 25 was 3.0243 s.

derived_time_conversions.converged_note: A peer up to ~72.0 s behind still counts as converged.
derived_time_conversions.diverged_note: A peer is only marked diverged after falling ~384.0 s (~6.4 min) behind.
derived_time_conversions.flag_period_note: 256 ledgers at the measured close step (Ledger.h:426 FLAG_LEDGER_INTERVAL).

rows.meaning: Default cap on untrusted manifests held in cache; overridable via [overlay] max_untrusted_count (comment at :279).
rows.name: defaultMaxUntrustedManifests

rows.meaning: The bound actually used, given an optional config override.
rows.name: untrustedManifestCount

measured_live.note: Live server_info corroborates the model quorum (17) but says nothing about the tuning constants — no constant above has ever been observed triggering on the testnet in this pack.

rows.meaning: A peer whose ledger sequence is within 24 ledgers of the validation's is treated as converged.
rows.name: convergedLedgerLimit

rows.meaning: A peer more than 128 ledgers behind the validation's is marked diverged.
rows.name: divergedLedgerLimit

rows.meaning: Soft cap on ledger entries in a single ledger-data reply.
rows.name: softMaxReplyNodes

rows.meaning: Hard cap: a ledger-node request carrying more IDs is rejected as bad data; a reply never exceeds this many nodes.
rows.name: hardMaxReplyNodes

rows.meaning: Timer intervals a send queue must stay large before the peer is disconnected.
rows.name: sendqIntervals

rows.meaning: Messages on a send queue at or above this count: queries are refused.
rows.name: dropSendQueue

rows.meaning: Sustained send-queue size considered reasonable.
rows.name: targetSendQueue

rows.meaning: Idle-peer sweep runs every 4th one-second timer tick, i.e. every 4 s.
rows.name: checkIdlePeers

rows.meaning: Maximum levels searched when answering a ledger query; deeper queries are rejected.
rows.name: maxQueryDepth

rows.meaning: Seconds waited between batches of connection attempts.
rows.name: secondsPerConnect

rows.meaning: Maximum simultaneous connection attempts.
rows.name: maxConnectAttempts

rows.meaning: Percentage of peer slots that are outbound; outbound count is max(minOutCount, outPercent * maxPeers).
rows.name: outPercent

rows.meaning: Hard minimum on outgoing connections.
rows.name: minOutCount

rows.meaning: Default total peer slots. Outbound count is max(minOutCount, outPercent * maxPeers) with special rounding; at defaults that is max(10, ~3) = 10 outbound peers.
rows.name: defaultMaxPeers

rows.meaning: Max redirects accepted from one connection (anti-flood).
rows.name: maxRedirects

rows.meaning: Fibonacci backoff in seconds between reconnect attempts to the same address (10 entries).
rows.name: connectionBackoff

rows.meaning: Boot address-cache entries above which the cache is trimmed (by 10%, line 94).
rows.name: bootcacheSize

rows.meaning: Incoming messages with more hops are dropped; each mtENDPOINTS carries 2*maxHops = 12 endpoints.
rows.name: maxHops

rows.meaning: Seconds between mtENDPOINTS messages per peer (prime, by design).
rows.name: secondsPerMessage

rows.meaning: How long an endpoint stays in the live cache.
rows.name: liveCacheSecondsToLive

rows.meaning: Seconds before an outgoing address is tried again.
rows.name: recentAttemptDuration
